policy: Exact SP set plus normalized title is triage evidence, not production identity or academic approval. SP-only, multiple, subset/superset and absent matches must not be auto-bound. v60 is staging source; Year 2–3 ordinary KSSR vs DPK and all live catalogue IDs must be separately verified. Preserve original objectives, PBD, source RPT and actual document bytes. No production changes.
